list.label: The Decoder：AI News（RSS）

detail.title: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
detail.description: Anthropic manager Felix Rieseberg says the classic coding interview is dead because Claude now solves small programming tasks better than job candidates do. He'd rather see prototypes that show taste, empathy, and principled thinking, since in his words, "hunger beats tenure." That sounds empowering, but it pushes the bar for newcomers toward entrepreneurial thinking and assumes a hustle mentality not everyone brings to the job.

list.title: NVIDIA 发布开放权重语音模型 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
list.label: The Decoder：AI News（RSS）

detail.title: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
detail.description: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcription, speaker recognition, and translation and takes its instructions as text prompts. It leads several benchmarks and uses only a sixth of the active parameters of its strongest open rival. Nvidia is also shipping a dataset with more than 800,000 hours of speech, along with tools for fine-tuning.
